additional_info.subject: Issue description EN
additional_info.body: Hello, there are currently problems with the charging power at the charging stations at the central warehouse. Our customer expects full power when the trucks are charged. Here is the information from the customer: after the initial teething issues are over, we want to get the most out of the charging stations and trucks. Unfortunately, some behavior changes after updates, with other issues we still have to reproduce the behavior, sometimes the Volvos and Ivecos behave differently. 10/21/2024 1:07 p.m. on the D300: instead of 300 kW, only 209 kW are delivered - the Iveco truck can handle around 350 kW. 10/21/2024 6:11 p.m. on the D160: instead of 160 kW, only 140 kW are delivered - the Volvo truck can handle around 240 kW. There also seems to be a phenomenon that the charging station regularly shuts down as soon as an Iveco truck is connected. Please check as soon as possible what the problem is! Thank you very much.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386150-DC/Si-D/DE-[jlxdQi]- Delivering less power CRM:00645000819
additional_info.body:
Hi Tanja,
We have analyzed the logs for both chargers and here are our findings:
Charger jlxdQi:
As per the timestamp you provided, we observed an anomaly where the power was briefly reduced to 140 kW. However, this issue was resolved within a few seconds. Once fixed, the charger resumed providing approximately 160 kW of power as requested by the EV.
DC2:
|
EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=151
|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=221
|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=149.9|
EVSE_NowCur[A]=220
|
EVSE_NowVol[V]=682
|
EV_TarCur[A]=221
|EV_TarVol[V]=701|EV_SOC[%]=44|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=160|Pilot=4
Regarding the anomaly, we will consult with our experts for further analysis.
Charger Jozhsr:
We checked the logs for the specified timestamp. The charger was delivering around 298 kW continuously for 68 minutes, as requested by the EV. Once the EV reached a SoC of 60%, the charger appropriately reduced the power, which is an expected behavior.
DC3: |
EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=298
|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=308|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=213.7|
EVSE_NowCur[A]=306
|EVSE_NowVol[V]=698|
EV_TarCur[A]=308
|EV_TarVol[V]=744|EV_SOC[%]=58|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=298.4|Pilot=4
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
